news.title: Dividend increased to ₹33.00
news.body: Dividend of ₹33.00 is 30% higher than last year. Ex-date: 3rd July 2026 Payment date: 29th August 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.0%, which is about the same as the industry average. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (22% earnings payout ratio) but not covered by cash flows (180% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 19% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 16% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (NSEI:M&M) executed a share purchase agreement to acquire an additional 16% stake in Carnot Technologies Private Limited for INR 67.2 million.
news.body:
Mahindra & Mahindra Limited (NSEI:M&M) executed a share purchase agreement to acquire an additional 16% stake in Carnot Technologies Private Limited for INR 67.2 million on April 27, 2026. Mahindra & Mahindra Limited acquired 5,608 shares constituting 28.03% of total paid up equity capital of Carnot Technologies Private Limited for INR 67.2 million. Upon completion of the said transaction, the Company’s holding in Carnot would increase to 80.72% of the paid-up equity share capital and collectively 89% in terms of voting rights. Carnot would continue to be the subsidiary of the company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹41.85 (vs ₹28.51 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹41.85 (up from ₹28.51 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹529.6b (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹46.7b (up 47% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.8% (up from 7.6% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 1.4% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.9% growth forecast for the Auto industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 38% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
